environment.cache_policy: fresh filesystem mount / FUSE process for each pass; warm backing image; no global cache drop

package.name: ISO9660 native optimized preparation
package.limits: Read-only, single-threaded FUSE service; no claim of complete Linux isofs feature parity.

comparison.resource_units: memory fields in KiB, except Threads; startup seconds include a completed root getattr
comparison.preparation: VKSO owner is the previously verified optimized binary; explicit bridge/frontend paths record user adapter variants
comparison.versions: ISO preparation uses Linux 5.15.198; LKL uses pinned Linux 6.12 fork; comparisons are complete implementations, not pure mechanism cost

interpretation: Tasks use warm backing images, fresh mounts/processes and tmpfs output; startup is separate.
Memory values are KiB except Threads. Rss/Pss come from smaps_rollup snapshots.
VmHWM is the asynchronously accounted status counter, not an exact observed peak.
User RSS/PSS do not measure total deployment memory; kernel module costs are separate.
LKL memory parameters are not measured RSS. Both default and reduced configurations are retained.
Linux 5.15.198 and LKL Linux 6.12 differ; cross-system effects are not page-sharing costs.
Only copied-fuse versus vkso-fuse uses identical core instructions and adapter code.
